question: Which among the following Chola emperors defeated the Pandya king Maravarman Rajsimha II in the battle of Vellore?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parantaka I**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Parantaka I** was a prominent Chola emperor who ruled from 907 to 955 CE.
 
• He is known for his military conquests and administrative reforms.
 
• Parantaka I defeated the Pandya king **Maravarman Rajsimha II** in the battle of Vellore.
